subject: Next steps & proposed times for PoC deep-dive — attendee confirmation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@mcafeehealth.com>, Tara Lin <tara.lin@mcafeehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery recap & proposed next steps

Hi Sam / Tara —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC deep-dive: 

Recap
- Goal: validate low-latency inferencing for clinical note summarization and ensure data retention controls meet McAfee Health requirements.
- Scope: 2 models (summarization, redaction), private deployment option (VPC) for PHI, 4-week PoC with sample throughput targets.
- Open items: ingestion format, retention/SOC2 evidence, and SSO requirements.

Proposed next step — technical deep-dive / PoC kickoff
I’d like to schedule a 60-minute technical session where our solutions engineer (Marissa) + platform lead (Karthik) walk through: architecture options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), quantization/latency tradeoffs, and a mutually agreed PoC scope.

Three proposed 60-min windows (all in US PST):
1) Tue Nov 23 — 09:00–10:00 PST (12:00–13:00 EST)
2) Wed Nov 24 — 13:00–14:00 PST (16:00–17:00 EST)
3) Thu Nov 25 — 08:00–09:00 PST (11:00–12:00 EST)

Please confirm: 1) preferred slot, 2) attendees from your side (roles), and 3) preferred bridge (Zoom or Google Meet). We can convert times to CET/APAC if that’s easier for any remote participants.

I’ve attached a short MVP scope and a draft mutual action plan to speed alignment. I’ll send a calendar invite as soon as we have a confirmed slot and attendee list.

Attachments: mvp-scope-brief.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com)

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed Nov 24 at 13:00 PST works for us. Attendees from McAfee Health:
- Sam Patel (Dir, Clinical Informatics)
- Tara Lin (Engineering Manager)
- David Chu (Security Architect)
- Priya Rao (Product Owner)

We generally prefer Google Meet for internal sessions (company policy + SSO). If Redwood can send a Google Meet link that’d be great. Also: can you include a short list of what sample data format you need for the PoC (CSV vs JSON lines)?

We reviewed the MVP scope at a high level and have minor edits — we can capture those during the session.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sam

Great — thanks for confirming, Sam.

I’ve booked the 60-minute deep-dive for:
Wed, Nov 24, 2027 13:00–14:00 Pacific (UTC-8)
Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rw-inference-mcafee (passcode: RWx42)
Calendar invite sent to all attendees (please accept/decline).

Planned agenda (60 min)
- 00–10 min: Introductions + security & data flow (Marissa)
- 10–35 min: Architecture options & latency/quantization tradeoffs (Karthik)
- 35–50 min: PoC acceptance criteria and sample data requirements (Jordan)
- 50–60 min: Next steps & action items (all)

McAfee deliverable request before the call
- One sample dataset (anonymized) in either newline-delimited JSON (preferred) or CSV.
- List of required compliance docs (if any) and contact for SOC2 questions (David? cc'd).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated with the confirmed date)
Calendar attachment: INVITE.ics (Google Meet included)

If anyone needs a Zoom bridge instead, I can add one as a fallback — let me know.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.
